hypothesis: The defect is that positional parsers silently associate results[i] with articles[i] even when counts differ or results are reordered. This parser detects the protocol (positional vs keyed) by checking for article_id in results, then: for positional, refuses on count mismatch; for keyed, uses article_id to match and refuses on duplicate/missing/unknown IDs, preventing misassociation.

syn-duplicate-id: keyed protocol with duplicate article_id should refuse duplicate_id
syn-missing-id: keyed protocol with 5 results for 6 articles should refuse missing_id or count_mismatch
